critical_failures.item: Expected total / claimed total (key: AUD 1,583.20, sum of the eleven lines; critical-failure triggers: reporting a mismatch not in the files, and a corrected total other than AUD 1,583.20)
critical_failures.quote: Claimed: AUD 1,583.40 (sum of the 11 line items; form states AUD 1,583.20; the line items exceed the stated total by AUD 0.20) ... Approved to reimburse now: AUD 1,583.40

deductions.reason: Corrected total does not match the key and the error is arithmetic, not a consequence of verdict errors (all eleven verdicts are Approve at claimed amounts, which sum to 1,583.20), so 0 of 10; the 5 for per-item amounts is kept as every approved amount matches the key.
